parsed.explanation: Documented, enforced criminalisation of gender expression (Art.266, 1 month-1 year, stacked morality/cyber charges to 3-4 years in 2018 sentences), women-only-venue exclusion, ISP/digital surveillance triggering prosecution, and a 2023 border examination involving forced shirt removal and inappropriate touching. No operative protection or remedy is documented; 2025 submission says criminalisation deepened and care/recognition banned. If outed, arrest, imprisonment and deportation are credible; execution/torture is not documented.

entry_documents.exposure: 2023 airport: visibly gender-nonconforming visitor held separately, shirt removed, inappropriately touched. No documented acceptance of foreign/X markers.
entry_documents.interaction: Border outing can lead directly to Art.266/morality investigation, detention and deportation.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: 2018-2020 police arrests for cross-dressing; preliminary court imposed 3-4 years plus OMR 3,000 fines. Custody placement not documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Digital photos/videos and unrelated investigations trigger cases; conviction can trigger mandatory deportation for foreigners.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Art.266 punishes impersonating opposite sex and entering women-only venues; 2020 arrest at women-only park hour, including foreign expat in abaya/niqab.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Facility use itself is the criminalised act; no identity-congruent access documented.

care_services.exposure: 2025 submission: gender-affirming healthcare explicitly banned; systemic institutional discrimination reported. Visitor care-access specifics not documented beyond ban.
care_services.interaction: Resident ban is climate signal; for visitor, medication/confiscation and emergency-care treatment are not_documented and cannot be assumed safe.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Same-sex conduct to 3 years; public indecency, morality-content and cybercrime laws used against LGBT expression; advocacy criminalised, assembly restricted.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State frames gender-nonconformity as impersonation/indecency; efficient enforcement is liability, not recourse.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented. No minor-specific rule documented; guardian arrest/deportation would foreseeably end family travel.
minors_guardians.interaction: Same adult criminal exposure applies if travelling adult is outed; no documented child-specific protection.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Police are documented perpetrators of arrests and 2023 border touching; no trans-specific homicide/violence magnitude documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Calling police risks being treated as offender under expression/morality laws rather than victim.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No effective remedy documented; advocacy criminal, earlier UPR recommendations reportedly ignored, 2025 submission reports deepened criminalisation.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Surveillance/registration unknowns do not offset documented enforcement; 2013 gay-foreigner screening proposal was stated unimplemented, current screening uncertain.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: routine arrest for presentation mismatch and imprisonment with illusory remedy. Lower than this case on custody torture/deaths and capital provision, which are not documented here, so this case sits slightly above 0.15.

Similar cross-dressing arrest and birth-sex/facility hostility, but this case is lower: 0.25-C has brief sentences and no execution, whereas here documented sentences reached 3-4 years and border sexual touching occurred.
Higher than 0.35-B: there, detention usually ends in release/fines without imprisonment. Here courts imposed multi-year imprisonment, so severity is materially greater and score lower.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime is one enforced system: border/document outing, women-only-venue criminalisation, morality/cyber laws and digital surveillance feed police arrest and prosecution, with deportation for foreigners. No documented protective law, facility access, care access or remedy interrupts that chain. Absence of documented execution or systematic custody torture keeps score above 0.15 anchors; documented multi-year imprisonment keeps it well below 0.25-0.35 anchors.
